audits.claim_text: On the revised 140 eligible E2 pairs, this Explorer version decides 125; the 15 unresolved pairs fall into carried arithmetic-state relations (10) and finite product-state explosion (5).
audits.scope: Full frozen population 142, with 1 forbidden any ACTION and 1 invalid service mapping separately excluded from the 140-pair behavioral denominator. 120 s/pair, grid 100 ms, binding decision false. Descriptive decision coverage only.

run_selection.selection_rule: Use the complete extension-v4 142-pair execution as final evidence, bound directly via artifacts in standalone mode. Keep all failures and the explicit 142-to-140 population revision. Prior subset executions are developmental, not independent replications. The final source rejects timestamp aliases across blocking continuations.

check_results.rationale: Full frozen 142-pair population rerun with the same 120 s cap, 100 ms input grid and binding decision false. Revised eligible denominator is explicitly 140, with both exclusions retained.
125 decided out of 140 eligible (89.3%) measures decision coverage, not independently verified accuracy. All 142 outcomes are retained; REF-EQUIV-CHECKED is not treated as an equivalence proof.
Same frozen pairs and budgets; all existing 104 verdicts preserved. No claim of cross-hardware runtime superiority.

43 EQUIV, 82 DIVERGE, 5 TIMEOUT, 12 REFUSED. Two input-invalid REFUSED are separately accounted for. All eight development probes and the older partial baseline are excluded from the final metric with reasons.
Finite benchmark coverage supports a bounded descriptive result. Related fault variants are not independent samples and no generalization significance claim is supported.
Implementation and population decisions were informed by observed failures; this is exploratory follow-up, not a held-out confirmatory evaluation.
Final source digests match workspace sources; complete result, source metadata, classification and regression artifacts are bound by SHA-256.
Repository-local continuity only: protected source files and frozen inputs remain unchanged relative to inherited baseline 580053a. No executor isolation or external immutability is claimed.
Implementation, candidate replay and this audit were performed by the same agent. The independent reference was not read or executed; new witnesses require separate verification.

independence.evidence: Explorer concrete replay is an implementation check, not an independent oracle. Frozen reference fields are historical comparator evidence only.

limitations: New DIVERGE witnesses have not been executed by the independent reference. C15/fault1 and C14_003/llm had REF-EQUIV-CHECKED on old histories and need particular follow-up.
Outcome-informed implementation and population revision are exploratory.
The two limitation types describe this evaluated population; other unsupported constructs in the supported-fragment contract still exist.
Calendar and timestamp overapproximations and candidate searches are incomplete; inability to certify is not an impossibility proof.
All 104 existing decisions are unchanged and no REF-DIVERGE became EQUIV, but this does not prove global absence of false EQUIV.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Five previously eligible timer faults now replay-confirmed; input-run compression preserves the first change time and boundary-directed search handles multi-stage histories.
All five E1-028 and two residue-only sample pairs now decided.
C15 correct/fault1, C18 correct and C19 correct are now decided.
Five C07 pairs still time out at 120 s; further product-state reduction deferred.
Ten E1-095/E1-099 pairs need relations involving accumulated/averaged output values or counter-dependent deadlines. E1-095 resets daily; this is not a claim that every value grows forever.
Use-site audit narrowed snapshot eligibility to nonblocking repeating JoI; dedicated negative test and complete full-population rerun passed.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Have the independent E2 owner replay all new witnesses under the unchanged binding/time model and the explicitly revised population before reporting final E2 correctness; keep C15/fault1 and C14_003/llm disagreement follow-up visible.
